detailed_descriptions.en: Embark on an exciting journey to the captivating landscapes of Greece, where every route unveils the country's breathtaking beauty and rich history. Explore the charm of inland Greece and discover enchanting islands. Picture yourself cruising through postcard-perfect villages, navigating winding roads, and passing iconic landmarks, immersing yourself in the centuries-old tapestry of Greek culture. Get ready for a journey that goes beyond the ordinary, celebrating the sun-kissed coastlines and cultural wonders of this Mediterranean gem. Your trucking adventures are about to reach new heights: Explore 15 major cities across Greece, including Athens and Thessaloniki, alongside smaller towns and settlements. Travel via Ferry to the islands of Lesbos, Chios, Kefalonia, Crete and Rhodes. Discover unique historical and natural landmarks including the Meteora Monasteries, the Fortress of Mytilene, Mount Olympus, the Corinth Canal and more! Travel through diverse terrains, from historical cities to coastal roads and mountainous regions. Drive across modern highways, winding country roads, and complex ports. Deliver to unique depots such as Hotels, olive oil processing plants, marble quarries, and the bustling Piraeus port. Discover a variety of viewpoints highlighting the Greek landscape and significant landmarks.
